property.condition: User-controlled report name may select shell interpretation at the command construction boundary.
property.benign_behavior: The production call submits report and quarterly to the injected runner and returns the runner response.
property.safety_property: The production call must pass the entire supplied name as one argument with shell interpretation disabled.
property.dependency_limits: Recording Runner may capture command and shell flag and supply a sentinel response; it must not implement argument construction or the shell-selection guard. This proves construction only, not operating-system execution.
